description_full: Suruga Bank Ltd. provides various banking and financial products and services to individuals and corporate customers in Japan. The company offers deposit products, such as time, non-interest bearing, savings, foreign currency, and other deposits, as well as current and general accounts; property, card, housing, second house, startup, and business up term loans, as well as loans by purpose; credit and debit cards; overdrafts; and other financing products. It also provides investment trust, public bond, pension contribution, insurance, inheritance/trust, lottery, foreign currency, pay-easy, web direct, safe deposit box, external linkage, remittance service, fund management, e-combination, payment, nursing care/medical care/dispensing compensation receivable factoring, mortgage, and internet and telephone banking services. In addition, the company offers money lending, guarantee, printing, leasing, and agency services, as well as advisory and consulting services. Suruga Bank Ltd. company was incorporated in 1895 and is headquartered in Numazu, Japan.

financial_summary: SURUGA BANK is a mid-cap financial services business with a $2.5B market cap on $427M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +3% over the past three years, which puts it in mature, slow-growth territory.
The company is burning through $946M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Management returns a meaningful 6.0% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 26% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
